verdict.rationale: Plain-text, dotfile-managed configuration is a fair question for any terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence pack documents iTerm2 storing or loading its settings from plain-text files, or syncing settings across machines. The only dotfile mention is the shell-integration installer modifying the user's shell dotfiles, which is a different capability. The 'mind-boggling number of options' claim says nothing about how those options are stored.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep the terminal's full configuration as plain-text files in my dotfiles and sync it across machines
